title: fix(enhanceConfiguration): deduplicate the hierarchicalFacets
body:
Fixes #3278

This PR backport the merge of the `hierarchicalFacets` from [`mergeSearchParameters`](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/6153a72066fed259a4eae30b4062894d2c86fbcc/src/lib/utils/mergeSearchParameters.ts#L38-L52) inside the implementation of `enhanceConfiguration`. It (finally) remove the issue with duplicated facets inside the request. This part of the code will be removed with the next major version in favor of the merge function. It ensures that the version 3.x.x won't have this issue anymore which implies Vue & Angular too.

**Before**

![before](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6513513/61542206-5d836880-aa41-11e9-8363-65615df7ab0e.gif)

**After**
